verdict.rationale: First-party reference docs for the Open WebUI Computer ecosystem describe an official CLI, but it has "exactly one command: cptr run" [open-webui-docs-38]. That is a narrow tool, not a broad CLI for managing or driving Open WebUI. The pip/uv install path [open-webui-gh-1] only implies a server launcher. missing for 10: documented CLI coverage beyond a single run command (e.g. chat, model, tool or automation management), examples of scripted or agentic CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
